description: Get detailed information about one or more Albert Heijn products by ID (max 20). Returns title, brand, category, description, price, unit size, bonus info, NutriScore, property icons. Set include_nutritional_info=true to also return calories, fat, protein, etc. Get product IDs from ah_search_products, or pass barcodes: the EAN number under a product's barcode (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, e.g. read from a photo of the pack). A barcode AH doesn't sell returns an error for it. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

barcodes.description: Barcode (EAN) numbers, e.g. ["8710400058519"]; counted in the max of 20 products (max 50 barcodes)

product_ids.description: Product IDs from ah_search_products, e.g. [123456] or [123456, 789012]; at most 20 products are fetched per call (max 50 ids)

name: ah_get_products
title: Albert Heijn: Product Details
